missionPremise: G-153 parcel 2 exists because a measurement said so: the Fleet and Police lenses refused 102 of 102 live records and therefore showed nothing useful. The parcel's real question was not 'write a mapper' but 'which of the three faults is a translation, which is a wrong shape, and which is a missing upstream' -- because collapsing them is the defect this operation keeps producing. This lane answered all three from the payload and at source, changed the DECLARATION deliberately where the declaration was wrong, derived the value where the value was simply never derived, and left the guard stricter than it found it. What the lane verified rather than assumed: the refusal reproduces on a deployed app as well as in a harness; the two apps were serving two different commits and therefore two opposite surfaces; the two dashboards lanes' file sets are disjoint; and the product suite on the merged tree is 847/847.
completionPredicate: Nine things readable by a stranger from artifacts rather than from this sentence: (1) the refusal reproduced over the live payloads with the three fault counts, before the change; (2) three explicit verdicts -- translation, wrong shape, missing upstream -- each with the payload or source evidence that decided it; (3) the guard shown STRICTER, not looser, by the same 102 of 102 verdict plus two new refusal clauses the old one could not express; (4) before-and-after renders of both regions across three vantages, one of which is a deployed non-production app; (5) both instruments passing on the built surfaces with non-zero matched inputs on every axis; (6) both instruments failing against planted violations, 6 and 17 of them, with the real surfaces restored byte-identically; (7) the product suite green at the branch head, 847 of 847; (8) DO-app reachability with the serving revision per app read BY FIELD, plus the four refusal directions and their keyed control; (9) the one clause still needing a deploy, NAMED, with the one-command re-probe that closes it. The tenth thing -- this branch's own mapping reached on a DO app -- is FAIL and named.

This lane's stub left SMARTCITY_V1_PLATFORM_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8099 set in the shell and the next `npm test` FAILED on src/platform-base.test.mjs:71, 'an unset base is the empty string, NOT a host', actual 'http://127.0.0.1:8099'. The failure is plausible, points at real product code, and is entirely the harness's. Before believing a suite result taken after harness work, clear the harness's variables -- and prefer a scratch shell for scratch work.

A REPRODUCE THAT RUNS AFTER THE CHANGE IT IS MEANT TO PRECEDE IS NOT A REPRODUCE. The refusal counts reproduced exactly, but the guard's WORDING moved with the fix, so re-running the reproduce command against the branch yields post-change sentences and a reader cannot tell whether the verdict was softened.
